name: survos/place-map-bundle
description: Open-source place library (OpenStreetMap point/polygon places) + Symfony UX Map integration: clustered, thumbnail-on-zoom item markers

suggest.survos/imgproxy-bundle: Server-side signed thumbnail URLs for map markers (falls back to raw source URLs without it).
suggest.symfony/ux-leaflet-map: The Leaflet/OpenStreetMap renderer bridge for symfony/ux-map — this bundle's assets (assets/controllers/place_map_enhance_controller.js) are written against it.
